reason: I travel twice a month and I always leave pills at home, so a tear-and-go sachet that fits in my gym bag actually fixes something for me. The named lab and the batch report make me willing to try one box at the $24.99 launch price.
objection: It is only magnesium bisglycinate when other products give me several forms in one capsule, so I am paying extra for the packaging more than for the formula. I would not reorder unless I can feel a difference.
